description: This PHP source file defines the MenuService class responsible for managing menu items, caching, and permissions within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with data access objects, permission services, and handles menu normalization and activation logic.

classes.name: MenuService
classes.description: Service class for managing application menus, including caching, permission checks, and menu item normalization.

methods.name: getMenuDao
methods.description: Returns the MenuDao instance, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionService
methods.description: Returns the ScreenPermissionService instance, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: enableModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Enables menu items for a given module and invalidates relevant caches.

methods.name: invalidateCachedMenuItems
methods.description: Clears cached menu data for the current user.

methods.name: getDetailedSidePanelMenuItemsAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves and caches detailed side panel menu items.

methods.name: getTopMenuItemsAlongWithCache
methods.description: Fetches and caches top menu items for a given side panel item ID.

methods.name: generateCacheKeyForTopMenuItem
methods.description: Generates cache keys for top menu items based on side panel IDs.

methods.name: getMenuItems
methods.description: Constructs the menu structure for a given base URL, including side panel and top menu items.

methods.name: getMenuItemChainForMenuItem
methods.description: Builds the hierarchy chain for a menu item.

methods.name: isActiveSidePanelMenuItem
methods.description: Determines if a side panel menu item is active based on current module and screen.

methods.name: isActiveTopMenuItem
methods.description: Determines if a top menu item is active based on current module and screen.

methods.name: normalizeMenuItem
methods.description: Normalizes a DetailedMenuItem into an array with URL and label, marking active state.

methods.name: normalizeTopMenuItem
methods.description: Normalizes a DetailedMenuItem into a hierarchical array for rendering, considering active state and children.
